pr.title: Fix race in session cache eviction
pr.body: Evictions could run while a write was mid-flight, leaving a dangling entry. Added a lock around evict() and a regression test. Also bumped the tokio dev-dependency because the test needed `time::pause`.

policy.auto_merge_allowed_for: test-only or docs-only changes with passing CI
policy.requires_two_reviewers: changes under src/auth or database migrations

change_kind.instructions: What kind of change is `pr` primarily?

criteria.bugfix: Fixes incorrect behavior in existing code
criteria.feature: Adds new user-facing or API behavior
criteria.dependency: Primarily a dependency or build change

concurrency_risk.instructions: Does `pr` change locking, threading, or async scheduling behavior?

criteria.true: Adds, removes, or moves a lock, or changes how concurrent work is scheduled

scope_creep.instructions: Does `pr.body` describe a change unrelated to the stated fix?

criteria.true: Bundles an unrelated change with the fix
criteria.false: Every described change serves the stated fix

review_depth.instructions: How careful should the human review of `pr` be?
criteria: Standard: read the diff, check the test
Deep: reason about edge cases, run locally, possibly pair
